stack-clip.title: Stack clip
stack-clip.blurb: Bayonet clip that locks two stacked crates (or a crate and a handle cap) together at the seam, so the stack lifts as one and the clip cannot be pulled straight off. Fits every box height.
stack-clip.material: PETG (PLA is too brittle for the hooks and detent finger)
stack-clip.print_notes: Print on its side, the detent-finger end (opposite the hooks) on the bed, so the hooks grow straight up from their stems; no supports, 100% infill, thin walls / Arachne on (hooks are 0.55 mm). To fit: tab down, push both hooks into the socket windows, slide 5 mm the way the hooks point until the detent clicks. To remove: slide back 5 mm, pull the tab. Two per side, four per seam.

tote-cap-2x2.title: Tote handle cap 2x2
tote-cap-2x2.blurb: Cap with a carry handle and clip sockets: clip it to the top crate and the whole stack becomes a grab-and-go tote.
tote-cap-2x2.print_notes: Print on its front face (-Y on the bed): the handle profile then has only vertical walls and 45 deg window sides, and the L clip sockets only bridge 1.6 mm; no supports. 4 walls, 20% infill.

tote-cap-3x2.title: Tote handle cap 3x2
tote-cap-3x2.blurb: Cap with a carry handle and clip sockets: clip it to the top crate and the whole stack becomes a grab-and-go tote.
tote-cap-3x2.print_notes: Print on its front face (-Y on the bed): the handle profile then has only vertical walls and 45 deg window sides, and the L clip sockets only bridge 1.6 mm; no supports. 4 walls, 20% infill.

nfc-cap-2x2.title: NFC label cap 2x2
nfc-cap-2x2.blurb: Lid hiding a 25 mm NTAG215 under a swappable label tile: tap a phone to open the box's inventory page.
nfc-cap-2x2.print_notes: Upright, no supports. Stick the NTAG215 in the round pocket, then snap the label tile over it.

nfc-label-tile.title: NFC label tile
nfc-label-tile.blurb: Snap-in label tile with embossed text; covers the NFC tag in the NFC cap.
nfc-label-tile.print_notes: Flat, text up, no supports. Filament swap at z = 1.6 mm for coloured text. Edit the text in make_label_tile().

tool-rack-cap-2x2.title: Tool rack cap 2x2
tool-rack-cap-2x2.blurb: Cap with a rack for four screwdrivers, flush cutters, wire strippers and three tweezers, so your hand tools ride on top of the stack.
tool-rack-cap-2x2.material: PETG (TPU 95A for a softer, rattle-free rack)
tool-rack-cap-2x2.print_notes: Upright, no supports (the L clip sockets in the rim only bridge 0.6-1.2 mm). 3 walls, 15% infill.
